Class BaseToolHandler

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.container.BaseToolHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
IToolHandler
Direct Known Subclasses:
MapToolHandler
public class BaseToolHandler extends Object implements IToolHandler
Default tool handler for BaseContainer. This class provides standard implementations for all tools, which can be used as-is or overridden by subclasses.

Dragging an already-selected item translates every selected item that is draggable and belongs to an unlocked layer. Locked and non-draggable items remain in place. Resize and rotate gestures continue to affect only the item whose handle initiated the gesture.

Author:
heddle

    • createRadArc

      public void createRadArc(GestureContext gc, Point[] pp)
      Description copied from interface: IToolHandler
      Create a radial arc.

      The expected interpretation of vertices is tool-defined; for a typical radial arc gesture:

      • vertices[0] = center
      • vertices[1] = radius leg endpoint
      • vertices[2] = angle-defining point
      Specified by:
      createRadArc in interface IToolHandler
      Parameters:
